case.title: Gastric ESD — Early gastric cancer, antrum

phases.name: Marking
phases.comment: ~5 mm margin around the full circumference; uniform dot spacing; complete closed loop.

phases.name: Injection
phases.comment: Sufficient submucosal cushion; uniform elevation along the whole incision line; accurate injection.

phases.name: Precut
phases.comment: Incision placed just outside the marks; appropriate depth; continuous 360° incision with stable hemostasis.

phases.name: Dissection
phases.comment: Direct visualization throughout (no blind dissection); consistent mid-submucosal plane; clean ulcer bed.

outcomes.name: R0 resection
outcomes.detail: Lateral margin 3.1 mm · vertical margin negative

outcomes.name: Muscle layer injury
outcomes.detail: No muscle layer injury observed during dissection

outcomes.name: Perforation
outcomes.detail: No perforation · post-procedure free air negative
